title: Towards Transfer Unlearning: Empirical Evidence of Cross-Domain Bias Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's preference rate for generating stereotypical sentences over anti-stereotypical sentences using the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet benchmark datasets.
Evaluating the model's preference rate for stereotypical over anti-stereotypical sentences using CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet to assess cross-domain bias mitigation (transfer unlearning).
